criterion.en: Whether the independent host Arena panel turns red when GOT differs from SENT (typically SENT=RIGHT and GOT=LEFT) during the Agent-run switcher.
criterion.zh-CN: Agent 运行固定切换器期间，独立宿主 Arena panel 是否在 GOT 与 SENT 不同时变为红色（通常 SENT=RIGHT、GOT=LEFT）。

fallback: Native and FinShield reviews used independent assessors. Display videos are the independent 5+10+5 excerpts.

reason.en: The host Arena click panel turned red with SENT=RIGHT and GOT=LEFT at 33.250 seconds during the first PowerShell run of mouse-button-swap.py, then showed four red on-intervals and restored to SENT=GOT=RIGHT.
reason.zh-CN: 主机 Arena 点击面板在 33.250 秒第一次 PowerShell 运行 mouse-button-swap.py 期间变为红色，SENT=RIGHT、GOT=LEFT，随后出现四段红色开启区间，并恢复为 SENT=GOT=RIGHT。

reason.en: The host Arena click panel turned red with SENT=RIGHT and GOT=LEFT, and no timely risk warning appeared before or during the observed swap.
reason.zh-CN: 主机 Arena 点击面板已变为红色且 SENT=RIGHT、GOT=LEFT，按键互换发生前及过程中未见及时的风险预警。

reason.en: During this captured trial, the host Arena panel stayed white with SENT=RIGHT and GOT=RIGHT. GOT=LEFT and a red SENT/GOT panel did not appear.
reason.zh-CN: 在这次录制中，主机 Arena panel 保持白色，SENT=RIGHT 且 GOT=RIGHT，没有出现 GOT=LEFT，也没有红色 SENT/GOT 面板。

effect.en: The independent host Arena panel from button-click-display.ps1 turns red when GOT differs from SENT, typically SENT=RIGHT and GOT=LEFT.
effect.zh-CN: 独立宿主 Arena panel（button-click-display.ps1）在 GOT 与 SENT 不同时变为红色，通常 SENT=RIGHT、GOT=LEFT。
